notablePrerequisites: You control at least three lands.
description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
